Apps.description: Welcome to Daily Puzzles where you can enjoy six puzzles in one app. Each day at midnight you’ll find, new, often topical puzzles, it's like always having a variety puzzle magazine with you. The design is simple, and, just like a magazine, there aren't scores or timers to worry about - you can focus on the joy of solving the puzzles. Exercise your mind everyday, for free, without ads.  See why thousands of people play everyday and why our loyal users have played 80 million puzzles!

Everyday Grids: Logic Puzzles

A fun daily brain boost — no pressure, just pure logic

Looking for a quick brain workout that actually feels good to play?
Everyday Grids is your daily dose of smart fun — packed with short, clever logic puzzles that keep your mind active without the stress.

From the creators of Everyday Puzzles, this new experience is all about logic — no words, no guesswork. Just satisfying challenges that help sharpen your focus, memory, and problem-solving skills. 

Packed with clever mini-games, daily challenges, and streak-based rewards, it's your perfect go-to for smart, relaxing gameplay.
Play it while you sip your coffee, take a break, or wind down.  A chill, satisfying way to give your brain a daily workout. 

Unique Mini-Games – 1 Brilliant Puzzle Hub
Every day brings a fresh set of puzzles designed to stretch your thinking in fun, bite-sized ways.
Each puzzle mode brings its own twist, charm, and logic challenge. 


Lotus
Inspired by Star Battle and Queens puzzles. Place one Lotus Flower in each color zone — no overlaps. Clean, strategic, and super satisfying.

Panda
Match each panda to its bamboo in this playful twist on Tents and Trees. Light-hearted logic at its finest.

Libra
Balance Fire and Ice icons evenly across the grid. Inspired by clever games like Binairo and Tango.

Zip
Trace a single path across the entire grid, visiting every cell. A satisfying journey where every step matters and every seed blossoms into a flower.

Sums
Fill the grid so every row, column, and color region hits the right total. A number-crunching challenge that adds up to pure fun.

Hashi
Link each sushi by building connections based on their numbers. A tasty twist on the classic Bridges that link the whole grid together.


New Puzzles Every Day
Play a fresh puzzle in each game mode daily! Solve them to:
-Keep your streak alive
-Unlock rewards and achievements
-Track your progress and grow your skills

Missed a day? No sweat — use the calendar to catch up anytime.

Even More Features to Unlock
Missions
Complete events and earn XP to unlock special puzzle badges.

XP Levels
Level up by earning XP as you play. The more you solve, the more you earn!

Badges
Collect unique badges from events and challenges to show off your puzzle skills.

VIP Membership
Go VIP to play ad-free and get access to exclusive perks and extras.

Why You’ll Love Everyday Grids:
-Addictive logic puzzles you can play every day
-Unique puzzle types — more coming soon!
-Fun, focused gameplay that fits your schedule
-Daily streaks, XP, and rewards to chase
-Free to play — no pressure, just good vibes

From the Makers of Fan Favorites
Created by Fanatee, the team behind CodyCross, Everyday Puzzles, Word Lanes, LunaCross, Stop, and Stop 2.
If you love brain games, this one’s for you.

Download Everyday Grids: Logic Puzzles now
Jump into the puzzle party, keep your streak going, and give your brain a daily treat — one clever grid at a time.

Tap, guide, and unwind with flowing sand.

Dive into a calming puzzle experience where every tap controls the movement of colorful sand. Send containers along a moving belt, gather grains by color, and watch images slowly appear as the sand cascades with smooth, lifelike physics. Easy to start, satisfying to master — each level delivers a relaxing yet engaging challenge.

Enjoy the soothing visuals of falling sand, responsive tap mechanics, and progressively evolving gameplay. Whether you’re looking to relax your mind or perfect your timing and strategy, this experience blends mindful play with rewarding puzzle progression.

Features
- Intuitive tap-based sand collection mechanics
- Conveyor-style movement and timing gameplay
- Match sand colors to reveal vibrant artworks
- Smooth, realistic physics simulation
- Increasing difficulty with new obstacles
- Polished animations and calming atmosphere
- Dozens of unique pictures to uncover
- Relaxing and addictive gameplay suitable for everyone

Create animated puzzle scenes with characters, objects and animals while learning new words! Beck and Bo is a puzzle game and pretend play adventure that helps children become familiar with objects of their world while building early vocabulary. 

Play and explore with Beck and Bo as they go on a train trip with their beloved dog, swim in the ocean with a giant whale, visit the jungle and meet amazing animals, play at the theme park and do a whole lot of exciting activities! 

• Parents’ Choice Award Winner 
• "One of the best apps for introducing toddlers to digital play" - USA Today
• "Pure perfection for toddlers!" - Teachers With Apps
• "Top Quality Edutainment for Preschoolers" - PadGadget
• "A nifty way to increase children's vocabulary" - TechWithKids
• "A wonderful app for toddlers and preschoolers, and unlike any other I have seen" - The iMums

BUILD YOUR SCENE
Build 12 thematic scenes with fun activities for Beck and Bo to play in: beach, jungle, grocery store, train trip, snowman, ocean, back yard, theme park, river boating, playground, city, bedroom. Each scene is like a puzzle that you put together by dragging & dropping characters, animals and objects to appropriate places. Kids have to think logically to find out where the puzzle pieces go: the sun in the sky, the fish in the water etc. Piece by piece, a beautiful, lively scene filled with sounds, words and animations comes to life!

PLAY HOUSE AND ENJOY FUN ACTIVITIES
This fun educational app offers a whole host of scenarios for creative pretend play. Play house in the bedroom and the back yard, pick and match food at the grocery store, swing and slide at the playground. Kids will love to swim and play ball at the beach, control the traffic in the city, pick apples from the apple tree, win prizes at the theme park and so much more! 

EXPLORE, EXPERIMENT, DISCOVER
Explore and discover all the fun activities and interactions within a scene. Think creatively and experiment to find out how objects work in different places. "I wonder what would happen if I put the dog in the dog house?". "What if I put Beck on the boat?". "Does the ball float in water?". 

LEARN NEW WORDS & SOUNDS
Tap on any object or animal in the scene to listen to its name and sound. The boat toots, the lion roars, the bird chirps. Toddlers & preschoolers build vocabulary and learn new words in visual context while making strong connections. Once a scene is completed, kids are rewarded by unlocking a sticker album where they can view all the scene’s objects, see how their words are spelled and listen to their sounds. 

MAIN FEATURES
• Build and play in 12 themed scenes with animated characters, animals & objects 
• City, beach, jungle, grocery store, back yard, playground & many more
• Tap an object to hear its name, place it in the scene to animate it and hear its sound 
• Animals, vehicles, fruits, vegetables and everyday objects
• More than 100 spoken words and sounds in visual context
• 12 sticker albums showcasing objects, written words & sounds
• Supports words in English and Swedish
• Ideal for toddlers & preschoolers
• Beautiful, cardboard-like artwork 
• Real-time physics
• No in-app purchases, no 3rd party ads

EDUCATIONAL VALUE
• Learn first words through playful exploration
• Enhance logic, creative thinking & puzzle solving skills
• Practice cause and effect
• Spark imagination with pretend play
• Enhance spatial cognition and observation skills
• Develop fine motor skills

PRIVACY POLICY
We respect your privacy! We do not collect, store, or share any personal information or location data. Our apps do not contain 3rd party ads and are safe for young children. View our privacy policy: http://avokiddo.com/privacy-policy

ABOUT AVOKIDDO 
Avokiddo is an award-winning creative studio specializing in the development of quality educational apps for kids. Learn more about us at www.avokiddo.com

Memory Games with Animals is a fun memory training game featuring over 290 graphics and cute sounds. This game will keep your kids entertained in the car, in a restaurant, or anywhere else. It helps train their memory and improve their recognition skills while they have fun.

Initially, all the memory cards will be face down. Select two cards by tapping on them. If the cards don't match, they will be turned face down again. Remember what's on the cards so you can find all the matching pairs.

You can adjust the game's difficulty by choosing boards of different sizes (3x4, 4x5, or 5x6).

CARD CATEGORIES

• Animals
• Dinosaurs
• Fish
• Birds
• Fruits and Vegetables
• Dogs
• Bugs
• Numbers

Some of these categories are available through In-App Purchase.

MAIN FEATURES

• Three levels of difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard
• Over 290 different card images
• 8 categories to choose from
• Easy-to-use interface
• Sound effects (can be turned on or off)
• No Ads
• Game Center Support. Global leaderboards showing most wins
• Universal App, full native support for iPhone and iPad
